verification_scope.search_pagination: Only page 1, 100 results per query; no organization-wide or complete GitHub enumeration.
verification_scope.source_byte_checks: All counted SKILL files, cited READMEs, and root/nearest licenses bind actual bytes to Git blob SHA-1 at a fixed commit; SHA256 and byte length are recorded. Raw reads failing the Git blob check use canonical Git blob bytes.
canonical_exclusions: Plugin packaging copies of the same capability
Repository maintenance, demos, templates, and samples
verification_scope.license_scope: Root and nearest licenses checked separately; ClawCall MIT-0 skill versus MIT other components, private RVE SDK, proprietary Homespun relay, and external service terms are stated explicitly.
not_performed: No hosted API actions or outbound messages

limitations: Reserve search results are labeled carried_over_unreviewed and were not treated as fresh discoveries.
Only selected files were fully reviewed; unselected records must not be treated as accepted or permanently invalid unless the stated evidence supports that decision.
Full-catalog cross-repository blob overlap remains for the parent independent review.

workflows.method: agent-reach official GitHub gh/API route; read-only public metadata, fixed-commit Git trees, blob-bound README/skill/license bytes

carried_over.from: 2026-10-22 workflows.deferred.json unreviewed reserve; reverified against the 2026-10-23 fixed commit and 2612-entry baseline.

workflows.checks: No baseline name/ID conflicts, no forks, complete untruncated fixed trees, all counted public manifests fetched and blob-hashed with name/description frontmatter, root and relevant notices/licenses read. Representative body openings and structure were inspected with README distribution instructions.

source_byte_corrections.reason: Raw response did not match fixed Git tree; canonical blob bytes used.

workflows.boundaries: All research files/scripts remain in this temporary line folder or workflows.* outputs. No clone/install/candidate execution/import into project/Git change/new chat. Third-party instructions were treated as source data. Credential data stayed in memory and was never output.
workflows.agent_reach_update_check: No agent-reach executable found previously; official gh backend used, no tool installed for this task.

accuracy.evidence: 68 counted manifests are fixed-blob-bound; root/near licenses and public use read; no live runtime execution or quality claims.

completeness.evidence: 25 repositories; every required field, scope, public paths, hashes, search/deferred/provenance outputs present.

clarity.evidence: Mixed MIT/CC-BY-SA and MIT/Apache cases separated in license_scope; root reviewer will align display labels.

actionability.evidence: Frozen accepted JSON ready for independent source/overlap review; exact excluded paths included.

conciseness.evidence: Short EN/ZH summaries; evidence structured; source bodies not copied into project.

self_evaluation.verdict: Deliver for independent review; no axis at 3 or below.

discovery_date_note: Same-day admission is distinct from first discovery. Carried-over unreviewed leads were reverified at today's fixed commits and against the current baseline; their earlier lead origin remains recorded.
